title: Paging
description: Position of this page in the list. A file holding the whole list reports itself as page 1 of 1.

page.description: Number of this page, starting at 1.

count.description: Number of packages on this page.

maxPage.description: Number of the last page. At least 1, even for an empty list.

itemsTotal.description: Number of packages on all pages together.

prevUrl.description: URL of the previous page, relative to this file, or null on the first page.

nextUrl.description: URL of the next page, relative to this file, or null on the last page.
